chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Maysarah, who said:

I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying concerning a man who saw something after ghusl: He said, if he had urinated after his intercourse before the ghusl, then let him perform wudu (ablution); but if he had not urinated until he performed ghusl, then afterward found moisture, then let him repeat the ghusl.

key_terms.الْغُسْلِ: ritual bath performed to remove janabah
key_terms.جِمَاعِهِ: his sexual intercourse, the cause of janabah here
key_terms.فَلْيُعِدِ الْغُسْلَ: let him repeat the ritual bath

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he finds moisture after ghusl from janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about finding moisture after ghusl from janabah. If one had urinated after intercourse before ghusl, only wudu (ablution) is required; if not, then the ghusl must be repeated. It highlights the importance of istibra' by urination before ghusl in rulings of ritual purity.
